content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Bastar District Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://bastar.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026 is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies are available for various posts including High Class Teacher, Subject Expert, Integrated Teacher, Computer Instructor, Vocational Sewing Instructor, and Part Time Music Teacher in the Bastar District Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates ranges from Rs. 5575 to Rs. 15000 per month, depending on the post they are appointed to.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Which educational qualifications are required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary for each post, ranging from 12th Pass to Graduate, B.Ed./D.Ed., M.A., PGDCA, and ITI/Diploma, along with RCI registration for certain categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application scrutiny, publication of a provisional merit list, inviting claims and objections, final selection/waiting list, and physical verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Bastar District, which is https://bastar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Women/PWD categories, up to 45 years, as per the prevailing government rules and regulations.
